info.title: OpenAI generation
info.description: API reference for OpenAI generation on Ace Data Cloud.

id.description: A unique identifier for the chat completion.

model.description: The model used for the chat completion.

object.description: The object type, which is always `chat.completion`.

index.description: The index of the choice in the list of choices.

role.description: The role of the author of this message.

id.description: The ID of the tool call.

type.description: The type of the tool call. Currently, only `function` is supported.

name.description: The name of the function to call.

arguments.description: The arguments to call the function with, as generated by the model in JSON format.

function.description: The function that the model called.

tool_calls.description: The tool calls generated by the model, such as function calls.

refusal.description: The refusal message generated by the model.

message.description: A chat completion message generated by the model.

finish_reason.description:
The reason the model stopped generating tokens. This will be `stop` if the model hit a natural stop point or a provided stop sequence,
`length` if the maximum number of tokens specified in the request was reached,
`content_filter` if content was omitted due to a flag from our content filters,
`tool_calls` if the model called a tool, or `function_call` (deprecated) if the model called a function.

logprobs.description: Log probability information for the choice.

choices.description: A list of chat completion choices. Can be more than one if `n` is greater than 1.

created.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the chat completion was created.

system_fingerprint.description:
This fingerprint represents the backend configuration that the model runs with.

Can be used in conjunction with the `seed` request parameter to understand when backend changes have been made that might impact determinism.

prompt_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the prompt.

completion_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the generated completion.

total_tokens.description: Total number of tokens used in the request (prompt + completion).

usage.description: Usage statistics for the completion request.

schema.description: Represents a chat completion response returned by model, based on the provided input.

parameters.description: Specifies the format of the response from the server.

n.description: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model.description: ID of the model to use.

stream.description: If set, partial message deltas will be sent, like in ChatGPT.

oneOf.description: The text contents of the message.

type.description: The type of the content part.
The type of the content part.

url.description: Either a URL of the image or the base64 encoded image data.

detail.description: Specifies the detail level of the image.

image_url.description: The image URL or base64 encoded image data.

type.description: The type of the content part. Always `input_audio`.

format.description: The format of the encoded audio data. Currently supports `wav` and `mp3`.

input_audio.description: The audio data to send to the model.

type.description: The type of the content part. Always `file`.

filename.description: The name of the file, used when passing the file to the model as a string.

file_data.description: The base64 encoded file data, used when passing the file to the model as a string.

file_id.description: The ID of an uploaded file to use as input.

file.description: The file data to send to the model.

oneOf.description: An array of content parts with a defined type. Can contain text, image_url, input_audio, and file inputs.

content.description: The contents of the message. Can be a string for text-only messages, or an array of content parts for multimodal messages (text, image_url, input_audio, and file).

name.description: An optional name for the participant. Provides the model information to differentiate between participants of the same role.

tool_call_id.description: Tool call that this message is responding to. Required when role is `tool`.

messages.description: A list of messages comprising the conversation so far.

max_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the chat completion.

temperature.description: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

response_format.description: An object specifying the format that the model must output. If not specified, the model will output text.

type.description: The type of the tool. Currently, only `function` is supported.

name.description: The name of the function to be called.

description.description: A description of what the function does.

parameters.description: The parameters the function accepts, described as a JSON Schema object.

tools.description: A list of tools the model may call. Currently, only functions are supported as a tool.

oneOf.description: Controls which (if any) tool is called by the model.

type.description: The type of the tool. Currently, only `function` is supported.

name.description: The name of the function to call.

oneOf.description: Specifies a tool the model should use.

tool_choice.description: Controls which (if any) tool is called by the model. `none` means the model will not call any tool. `auto` means the model can pick between generating a message or calling one or more tools. `required` means the model must call one or more tools.

post.summary: Creates an embedding vector representing the input text.

embedding.description: Embedding vector or base64-encoded embedding, depending on encoding_format.

model.description: Model used to generate the embeddings.

created.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the embeddings were created.

parameters.name: accept
parameters.description: Specifies the format of the response from the server.

prompt.description: A text description of the desired image(s). The maximum length is 32000 characters for GPT image models, 1000 characters for `dall-e-2`, and 4000 characters for `dall-e-3`.

background.description: Set transparency for GPT image models. Must be `transparent`, `opaque`, or `auto` (default). If `transparent`, choose an output format that supports alpha (png/webp).

model.description: The model to use for image generation. Defaults to `dall-e-2` unless a GPT-image-only parameter is supplied.

moderation.description: Content-moderation level for GPT image models. `low` relaxes filtering; `auto` applies the default.

n.description: How many images to generate. Must be between 1 and 10. For `dall-e-3`, only `1` is supported.

output_compression.description: Compression level (0-100%) for GPT image models when using `webp` or `jpeg` output formats.

output_format.description: Return format for GPT image models. Must be `png`, `jpeg`, or `webp`.

partial_images.description: Number of partial images to emit during streaming (0-3). `0` returns the final image in one event.

size.description: The size of the generated images. GPT image models: `1024x1024`, `1536x1024` (landscape), `1024x1536` (portrait), or `auto` (default). `dall-e-2`: `256x256`, `512x512`, or `1024x1024`. `dall-e-3`: `1024x1024`, `1792x1024`, or `1024x1792`.

quality.description: Quality of the image. GPT image models: `auto` (default), `high`, `medium`, `low`. `dall-e-3`: `hd` or `standard`. `dall-e-2`: `standard`.

response_format.description: The format in which `dall-e-2`/`dall-e-3` images are returned: `url` or `b64_json`. Not supported for GPT image models (they always return base64).

callback_url.description: Optional callback URL. When provided, the API returns a `task_id` immediately and POSTs the result to this URL once image generation completes. The callback payload includes `task_id`, `trace_id`, `success` (boolean), and the full response data or error.

parameters.name: accept
parameters.description: Specifies the response format. Only `application/json` is supported.

image.description: Image(s) to edit. GPT image models: up to 16 images (png/webp/jpg) <50MB each. `dall-e-2`: single square PNG <4MB.

prompt.description: Text description of the desired edit. Max 1000 characters for `dall-e-2`, 32000 for GPT image models.

background.description: GPT image models only. Transparency handling: `transparent`, `opaque`, or `auto` (default). Use `png`/`webp` output when requesting transparency.

input_fidelity.description: How strongly to match input style/features. Supported for `gpt-image-1`; not supported for `gpt-image-1-mini`.

mask.description: Optional mask (PNG <4MB, same dimensions as first image). Transparent areas indicate editable regions.

model.description: Model for image editing. Only `dall-e-3` and GPT image models are supported.

output_compression.description: Compression level (0-100%) for GPT image models when using `webp` or `jpeg` output.

output_format.description: Return format for GPT image models: `png`, `jpeg`, or `webp`.

partial_images.description: Number of partial images in streaming responses (0-3). `0` returns only the final image event.

quality.description: Image quality. GPT image models: `auto` (default), `high`, `medium`, `low`. `dall-e-2`: `standard` only.

response_format.description: Format for `dall-e-2` responses: `url` or `b64_json`. GPT image models always return base64.

size.description: Image size. GPT image models: `1024x1024`, `1536x1024` (landscape), `1024x1536` (portrait), or `auto`. `dall-e-2`: `256x256`, `512x512`, or `1024x1024`.

callback_url.description: Optional callback URL. When provided, the API returns a `task_id` immediately and POSTs the result to this URL once image editing completes. The callback payload includes `task_id`, `trace_id`, `success` (boolean), and the full response data or error.
